title: Calendars are Scary
description:
People think an ATS robot (which isn’t even what the image represents it to be) is the scariest thing in the job search but you can actually work around that. The hardest thing in the job search is how so much of timing is out of your control. Just keep that in mind if you get rejected for a job you’re absolutely qualified for. #jobapplication #jobapplications #jobapplicationtips
